stem: The table shows a grouped frequency distribution. Class ${=b0} \le x < {=b1}$: frequency ${=3*k}$. Class ${=b1} \le x < {=b2}$: frequency ${=3*k}$. Class ${=b2} \le x < {=b3}$: frequency ${=k}$. Class ${=b3} \le x < {=b4}$: frequency ${=k}$. Using the centres of the classes, calculate the standard deviation.
solution: The class centres are ${=c-w}$, ${=c}$, ${=c+w}$ and ${=c+2*w}$, with total frequency ${=8*k}$.
Variance $=\frac{{=8*k*w*w}}{{=8*k}}={=w*w}$, so the standard deviation is $\sqrt{{=w*w}}={=w}$.
notes: Population SD. Centres spaced w apart with offsets -1,0,1,2 and freqs 3k,3k,k,k give mean c, SD w. Placeholder parent id.
